plan.root_cause: The Pikaday date picker's keyboard handler (_onKeyChange) does not handle the Tab key (keyCode 9). When a user types a date in the bound input field and presses Tab, the picker remains open and its focusable elements (day buttons, navigation buttons) intercept the Tab navigation, preventing focus from moving to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a case for keyCode 9 (Tab) in the _onKeyChange switch statement. When Tab is pressed while the bound input field is focused (e.target === opts.field), hide the picker to release its focus trap and allow the browser's default Tab behavior to move focus to the next form field.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now tab from the date input field to the next form field (guests) after typing a date, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Minimal - only affects Tab key behavior when the picker is visible and the input field is focused
Arrow key navigation within the picker remains unchanged
Date selection with Enter/Space still works
Picker closes on Tab from field as intended
verification_requirements: Tab from checkin field moves focus to guests field
Arrow keys still navigate dates when picker is open
Date selection with Enter/Space still works
Picker closes on Tab from field

plan.root_cause: The Pikaday date picker's focusable elements (previous/next month navigation buttons and day buttons) are in the default tab order. When the picker is open, these elements intercept Tab navigation from the bound input field, preventing focus from moving to the next form field (guests). The picker's aria-label instructs users to 'Use the arrow keys to pick a date', confirming that Tab should not be used for internal picker navigation.
plan.repair_strategy: Add tabindex="-1" to all focusable buttons within the picker (pika-prev, pika-next, pika-day) so they are removed from the sequential tab order. The month/year selects already have tabindex="-1". Keyboard users navigate the picker via arrow keys on the input field (handled by _onKeyChange), while Tab naturally moves to the next form field. This follows the APG date picker pattern and preserves native browser focus behavior.
